context.narrative_job: Combine readiness, timing and inaction, show owner stakes, then reveal that everyone around a sale is paid by the transaction and nobody owns the preparation work.
context.viewer_before: Half of exits are unplanned; the timing is not the owner's.
context.viewer_after: The viewer sees the unowned preparation role: the vacancy.

data.choice: Part A built: recap card, EPI owner-survey card, everything-they-own box with '= the retirement', 'So who helps?' question card. Parts B-D proposed as the room model, a quote card and the empty seat at 'three years out'.
data.reason: Survey claims need attributable surfaces; the stake is a proportion without a figure; the vacancy is a missing role best shown as negative space in the established model.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: S10 just ended on the presenter; adds cost without new information.

alternatives.choice: Pie or bar of net worth
alternatives.reason_not_selected: Would imply the 80% figure the script does not say.

reuse.applies_when: A section moves from survey evidence to an incentive structure and a missing role.
reuse.avoid_when: The evidence already has a sourced visual precedent that fits better.

nuance.false_inference: That unpreparedness proves demand, that any owner's retirement is destroyed, or that advisers act improperly.

data.method: HyperFrames strict check; contact sheets and one layout fix (stat column width, removed confusing subline); render; context assembly after locked S10; audio correlation.
data.scope: S11 part A (645 frames) in context.
data.limitations: Owner review pending; parts B-D not built.
